risk: Input protection architecture or candidate may not satisfy the actual 24 V use envelope
cause_or_uncertainty: Q-C01/Q-C02/Q-C03 and applicable domain/profile are unresolved
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Obtain approved customer/OEM profile; derive envelope; compare datasheet limits with margin; approve decision record

risk: Power rails may be undersized or overheat
cause_or_uncertainty: USB, display, serial loads and ambient/enclosure conditions are unknown
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Collect Q-C04/Q-C05/Q-C06/Q-C08 inputs; create reviewed worst-case rail and thermal budget before part approval

risk: Serial interface cannot meet required stream count or behavior
cause_or_uncertainty: CF-09 topology, concurrency and frozen GPIO record unresolved
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Close Q-C07/Q-C08; validate native/selected serializer capacity and stress-test plan; do not count speculative capacity

risk: TFT/LCD requirements cause GPIO, memory, power or boot conflict
cause_or_uncertainty: Q-C05/Q-C11 and display interface/pin needs unresolved
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Get approved signal and power specification or signed scope exclusion; recalculate GPIO/PSRAM budget

risk: Protection/compliance criteria may target the wrong product domain
cause_or_uncertainty: CF-08, Q-C09 and functional criteria are unresolved
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Approve product domain, applicable profile, ports, test levels and function class before claiming compliance

risk: Part or source provenance is incomplete, conflicting, or not redistributable
cause_or_uncertainty: PKG-A/B/C integrity, license, upstream hash, or applicability may be incomplete
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Record package manifest, hashes, licenses, source locators, conflicts, and approved scope/disposition

risk: Premature schematic entry encodes assumptions as design facts
cause_or_uncertainty: G1 is BLOCKED and exact-part/load/profile inputs are unresolved
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Require approved G1/G2 authorization, frozen inputs, and signed checklist before schematic entry

risk: Tool-generated PASS is misinterpreted as gate or hardware validation
cause_or_uncertainty: WF01-D1 is a design-time decision aid only
mitigation_or_exit_criteria: Preserve RULE_ONLY scope, limitations, approval record, and separate physical verification evidence
